refs.label: Norton AntiTrack product page
refs.proves: AntiTrack features, 'disguise' wording, unlimited aliases, dashboard, AntiTrack pricing — live-verified 12 Nov 2026 (device selector tested at all tiers: 1 Device $34.99 first yr, renews $49.99; 5 Devices $49.99 first yr, renews $59.99; 10 Devices $59.99 first yr, renews $69.99; no $29.99 price anywhere on the page)

refs.label: Norton support: Privacy Monitor vs Assistant
refs.proves: Current text of the rewritten page (checked 12 Nov 2026): “Privacy Monitor Assistant (PMA) is a paid service” — offered as an add-on / standalone / in certain benefit plans, not as part of retail Select Plus (whose plan page lists “Privacy Monitor”, no PMA); “Supported sites only: Privacy Monitor and Privacy Monitor Assistant only cover supported data brokers”. PMA Lite is a lighter automatic removal included only with some newer LifeLock & partner plans — smaller broker set, no agent, no Online Account Cleaner. The page no longer carries the older sentence that Select Plus includes Privacy Monitor only — that wording is not quoted as current text anywhere in this comparison

refs.label: Norton support: AntiTrack anti-fingerprinting (“dummy data”)
refs.proves: The fingerprint “dummy data” wording lives on this support page, not on the AntiTrack product page: anti-fingerprinting returns dummy data to websites that request fingerprint information (checked 12 Nov 2026)

refs.label: Norton support: Windows OS Tracker Blocking
refs.proves: The Windows OS Tracker Blocking wording lives on this support page, not on the AntiTrack product page: AntiTrack blocks tracking activities and targeted ads by the Windows operating system (checked 12 Nov 2026)

refs.label: Norton privacy solutions page
refs.proves: Privacy Monitor is a standard feature in LifeLock Standard/Advantage/Ultimate Plus and Norton 360 Deluxe / with LifeLock Select / Advantage / Ultimate Plus; 'Privacy Monitor Assistant is a standalone white-glove service available as a paid add-on'

refs.label: Norton Privacy Monitor feature page
refs.proves: Scan + request opt-out yourself; revisit every 3 months

refs.label: Norton Privacy Monitor Assistant product page
refs.proves: PMA $109.99/yr or $12.99/mo, 'over 2,000' data broker sites, rescan every 90 days — on the main site (us.norton.com), checked 4 Nov 2026

refs.label: Norton support: opt-out guide (32 brokers with instructions)
refs.proves: Norton's opt-out guide names 32 brokers with step-by-step instructions (DocID v2023040613553951, read in full 12 Nov 2026). 7 of the 32 — CanadaPages, CheckPeople, ClustrMaps, PrivateReports, Public Data USA, Radaris, Truepeoplesearch — are NOT on the 367-name support list, so Norton's supported set in this comparison is the union of both Norton pages: 374 names, each row showing its page

refs.label: ReputationDefender: Defender — online content suppression
refs.proves: 'Push negative content or misleading search results down to pages where virtually nobody will ever see them'; FAQ: content can in certain cases be 'permanently deleted'. Bronze / Silver / Gold tiers, 12 months. No price published — 'A reputation management specialist will review your situation with you over the phone and make a recommendation'

refs.label: ReputationDefender: VIP Services / Special Projects
refs.proves: 'Reorder your search results to amplify true, positive materials and de-emphasize attacks or misleading items'; 'Change the suggested terms that people see when they start searching for you or your company'; 'Control which images and videos appear in your main search results, your knowledge graph, and in image and video searches'. No price published — Special Projects techniques 'are very resource-intensive and expensive'

refs.label: ReputationDefender: Defender Local — online reviews
refs.proves: Defender Local review management: 'Monitor your reviews across the most important third-party review sites, including over one hundred industry-specific sites'; 'Receive alerts for new online reviews and respond directly from the platform'; business listings on hundreds of top listings sites. Prices as published: Local Essentials $2,000/yr, Local Premium $3,500/yr. FAQ: Defender Local does NOT delete negative reviews

refs.label: ReputationDefender: ReputationGrower — personal branding
refs.proves: 'Your own personal website (e.g. johnsmith.com)', 'two professional biographies and a personal mission statement crafted by our expert writers'; 'Cloud-based dashboard to track your online presence in the search results'; 'Score your search results in real time'. $995 one-time — 'you do not need to pay us anything beyond the one-time engagement fee' (not an annual price)

refs.label: ReputationDefender: About — part of Gen Digital
refs.proves: 'ReputationDefender is now part of Gen Digital Inc.'; 'The Norton, LifeLock by Norton, and Avira brands, products, and services are part of Gen Digital Inc.' Norton's support FAQ adds: 'ReputationDefender was acquired in September 2021'. No Norton page states ReputationDefender is included in any Norton 360 / LifeLock plan — it is sold separately via reputationdefender.com

refs.label: ReputationDefender: ExecutivePrivacy — custom removal requests
refs.proves: ExecutivePrivacy (executive/corporate privacy): “Custom removal requests, when possible” — qualified, quote-led, no price published, no consumer product (checked 12 Nov 2026)

refs.label: ReputationDefender: Total Radius — custom data removals
refs.proves: Total Radius (executive protection): “Custom Data Removals — By default we cover hundreds of online data removal scenarios—but if you do find something new, our team will determine the best way to mitigate it for you”; also “PII removals make it harder for would-be attackers to locate you or your team” — the Norton-side basis for the business products reading partial / different (checked 12 Nov 2026)

refs.label: ReputationDefender: VIP Services — custom removal requests
refs.proves: VIP Services: “Deep Web privacy protection, including custom removal requests and social media scanning” — executive/corporate only, quote-led, no price published (checked 12 Nov 2026)

stackNote: Two separate purchases. Select Plus includes Privacy Monitor (scan + manual opt-out) only — NOT Privacy Monitor Assistant; automated removal is the $109.99/yr add-on (PMA Lite, a lighter automatic removal, is included only with some newer LifeLock/partner plans, not these retail suites). Select Plus renews $189.99/yr. Ultimate Plus suite alone is $299.99 first yr / $364.99 renewal — and it also includes Privacy Monitor only, before the same add-on.
